title: 第3章 脱胎换骨第4章 仗势欺人
content_zh:
然而，面对这般沉重的代价，江若尘仅仅是思考了一秒就做出了决定：“前辈，晚辈愿意学【九龙神诀】！”
老龙显然有些意外，没有想到江若尘能这么快的做出决定：“这么快就想好了，不再考虑？【九龙神诀】不仅痛苦，而且凶险万分，一旦失败……”
“前辈，晚辈想清楚了，我一定要学【九龙神诀】！
如果活得如同蝼蚁，我宁愿一死！”
江若尘双拳紧握，一脸坚决。
刚才犹豫的那一秒内，他想到了今日江立的羞辱，婉妃的期待，也想到了蓝星……他还有家人。
所以他必须要改善体质，觉醒龙魂。
看着坚决的江若尘，老龙微微点头，像是赞赏。
“好！”
老龙不再耽误时间，淡化的龙爪轻轻一点，一道光束就打入了江若尘的脑海。
顿时江若尘就感觉脑袋要炸开了一般，一本无上的锻体法门【九龙神诀】，在与他的神识融合。
很快，痛感消失，也代表【九龙神诀】的功法，他全都记下了。
“功法你已完全融合，接下来就该正式开始锻体了，只是你体内没有丝毫灵气存在，我再助你一臂之力，但我太虚弱了，不能动用过多的灵气帮你，在锻体开始后，你不仅要承受痛苦，更要试着开拓筋脉，自主吸收灵气，只有这样你才能彻底完成锻体。”
老龙见江若尘恢复，立马要正式开始锻体。
江若尘已经完全融合【九龙神诀】，所以对【九龙神诀】的锻体原理有更清楚的认知。
所谓锻体，就是用霸道的灵气，日复一日的主动摧毁自身的筋脉，骨骼，而后再依靠自身的恢复力恢复。
长时间一直循环往复下来，身体的筋脉，骨骼就会越来越坚韧，体质也就越来越强。
这就好比锻造兵器一般，要想兵器锋利，坚硬，就要经历无数次的烈火淬炼，铁锤击打。
承受的淬炼，击打越多，剑身越坚硬，剑刃也更加的锋利！
正常锻体，都需要日积月累，而江若尘没有多余的时间，他只有一夜的时间来锻体，提升自己的体魄。

【九龙神诀】的作用就在于，能集千日之功于一夜，快速的让江若尘承受他人千日的锻体。
同样，他人所承受的千日痛苦，也会被压缩至一日。
说得通俗点，要想速成，就要一次性承受别人千百次锻体的痛苦。
那种痛苦，无法想象。
不过即使如此，江若尘决定用【九龙神诀】锻体的心，没有丝毫的动摇。
江若尘原地盘坐下来：“来吧前辈！”
“好！”
老龙再次一指，一股夹杂着龙气的霸道灵气直接打入江若尘体内。
唔！
霸道的灵气突然入体，江若尘的身躯本能一颤，接着，一股巨大的痛苦感开始在四肢百骸传来。
霸道的灵气疯狂游走，让他感觉自己的肌肤既像在被什么东西捶打，又好像熊熊烈火在燃烧，产生剧烈的疼痛。
“啊！”
巨大的痛苦，让江若尘本能的发出声音，但很快又被他强行咬牙忍住。
只是他还未有一丝的适应，老龙的声音再次响起：“江若尘，还不用【九龙神诀】，加大锻体的力度？”
“是，前辈。”
江若尘不敢耽搁，立刻就按照【九龙神诀】的办法开始推动体内的灵气。
不知是何故，在【九龙神诀】运转的瞬间，体内本就霸道的灵气好似受到了刺激一般，更加疯狂了起来。
捶打力度加大，灼烧感更是严重了几十倍。
content_en:
However, facing such a heavy price, Jiang Ruochen only thought for a second before making a decision: "Senior, this junior is willing to learn the [Nine Dragons Divine Art]!"
Old Long was obviously a little surprised. He didn't expect Jiang Ruochen to make a decision so quickly: "Have you thought about it so quickly and stopped thinking about it? [Nine Dragon Divine Art] is not only painful, but also extremely dangerous. Once it fails..."
"Senior, junior, please think clearly, I must learn the [Nine Dragon Divine Art]!
If I live like an ant, I would rather die! "
Jiang Ruochen clenched his fists with a determined look on his face.
In the second of hesitation just now, he thought of Jiang Li's humiliation today, Concubine Wan's expectations, and also thought of Lan Xing... and his family.
Therefore, he must improve his physique and awaken the dragon soul.
Looking at the determined Jiang Ruochen, Old Long nodded slightly, as if in appreciation.
"Okay!"
The old dragon didn't waste any more time. With a tap of his faded dragon claw, a beam of light penetrated Jiang Ruochen's mind.
Suddenly, Jiang Ruochen felt as if his head was going to explode. The supreme body-building method [Nine Dragon Divine Art] was merging with his consciousness.
Soon, the pain disappeared, which also meant that he had memorized all the techniques of the [Nine Dragon Divine Art].
"You have completely integrated the exercises. Now it is time to officially start the exercise. However, there is no spiritual energy in your body. I will help you again, but I am too weak to use too much spiritual energy to help you. After the exercise starts, you will not only have to endure the pain, but also try to open up the muscles and absorb the spiritual energy on your own. Only in this way can you completely complete the exercise."
Seeing Jiang Ruochen's recovery, Old Long immediately wanted to officially start exercising.
Jiang Ruochen has completely integrated the [Nine-Dragon Divine Technique], so he has a clearer understanding of the body-building principle of the [Nine-Dragon Divine Technique].
The so-called body training is to use domineering spiritual energy to actively destroy one's own tendons and bones day after day, and then rely on one's own recovery power to recover.
If this cycle is repeated for a long time, the muscles and bones of the body will become stronger and stronger, and the body will become stronger and stronger.
This is like forging a weapon. If you want the weapon to be sharp and hard, it must be tempered by fire and struck by hammers countless times.
The more tempering and blows it endures, the harder the sword body becomes and the sharper the blade becomes!
Normal physical training requires accumulation over time, but Jiang Ruochen had no extra time. He only had one night to train and improve his physique.
The function of [Nine Dragon Divine Techniques] is that it can gather the work of a thousand days in one night, and quickly allow Jiang Ruochen to withstand the training of others for a thousand days.
Similarly, the pain that others endured for a thousand days will be compressed into one day.
To put it simply, if you want to achieve success quickly, you have to endure the pain of thousands of other people's exercises at once.
That kind of pain is unimaginable.
But even so, Jiang Ruochen's decision to use the [Nine Dragon Divine Art] to fortify his body did not waver at all.
Jiang Ruochen sat down and said, "Come on, senior!"
"Okay!"
The old dragon pointed again, and a domineering spiritual energy mixed with dragon energy directly penetrated into Jiang Ruochen's body.
Ugh!
The overbearing spiritual energy suddenly entered his body, and Jiang Ruochen's body trembled instinctively. Then, a huge pain began to spread throughout his limbs.
The domineering spiritual energy traveled wildly, making him feel as if his skin was being beaten by something, and as if a blazing fire was burning, causing severe pain.
"Ah!"
The huge pain made Jiang Ruochen instinctively make a sound, but he quickly gritted his teeth to hold back.
But before he could get used to it, Old Long's voice sounded again: "Jiang Ruochen, why don't you use the [Nine Dragon Divine Art] to increase the strength of your body training?"
"Yes, senior."
Jiang Ruochen did not dare to delay and immediately started to push the spiritual energy in his body according to the method of [Nine Dragon Divine Art].
For some unknown reason, at the moment when the [Nine Dragon Divine Art] was operating, the overbearing spiritual energy in his body seemed to be stimulated and became even crazier.
Beating harder, the burning sensation was dozens of times more severe.
